versions.content: To save the context the crypto driver object shall store all relevant workspace data of the currently active primitive that was modified by previously processed START and UPDATE operation and shall place them into job->outputPtr (so-called snapshot of context data). The length of the provided data shall be written to the memory where job->outputLengthPtr references to. The function shall return E_OK if the operation was successful.
